content: Official React Native accessibility documentation recommends meaningful accessibility labels on accessible controls; Android accessibility and Apple HIG provide platform-specific guidance. Plan screen-reader, large-text, touch, reorder-without-drag, and Portuguese/English content checks on actual iOS and Android phones. Sources: reactnative.dev/docs/accessibility; developer.android.com/guide/topics/ui/accessibility; developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility
